Focused DUI Efforts in Newberg & Dundee
detail: <p>During the holiday season of December 2025, through New Year's Day 2026, the Newberg-Dundee Police Department focused on taking impaired drivers off the roadway in the cities of Newberg &amp; Dundee. During that time, 7 DUI arrests were made, including one arrest made during a shift that was funded by the Oregon Department of Transportation. Grant funds are used to put more officers on the road during peak holiday times when impaired driving can be more prevalent.&nbsp; NDPD participates in several similar operatons throughout the year to encourage safer roadways.</p>

<p><strong style="font-size:20px">MEDIA ADVISORY: PORTLAND METRO CHAMBER&nbsp;TO&nbsp;RELEASE FINDINGS OF NEW POLL&nbsp;ON VOTER&nbsp;ATTITUDES&nbsp;—&nbsp;RSVP&nbsp;TO BRIEFING AND BREAKFAST FORUM</strong><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:20px">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">Every fall, the&nbsp;Portland Metro&nbsp;Chamber partners with&nbsp;</span><a class="Hyperlink SCXW151751294 BCX0" href="https://www.dhmresearch.com/about/" rel="noreferrer noopener" style="font-size: 16px; -webkit-user-drag: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; user-select: text; text-decoration-line: none;" target="_blank"><span style="color:rgb(70, 120, 134); font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif">DHM Research</span></a><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">&nbsp;to survey voters across the Portland metropolitan area, tracking public sentiment on key issues, like economic outlook, top priorities, quality of life, and trust in elected leaders. This research shines a valuable light on the electorate’s state-of-mind&nbsp;and highlights&nbsp;new potential opportunities for public policy.&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">&nbsp;</span></p>
</div>

<div class="OutlineElement Ltr SCXW151751294 BCX0" style="-webkit-user-drag: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; user-select: text; clear: both; cursor: text; overflow: visible; position: relative; direction: ltr; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Web&quot;, Arial, Verdana, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">
<p><span style="font-size:16px"><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif">&nbsp;</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">For&nbsp;its&nbsp;</span><strong style="font-size:16px">first Breakfast Forum of 2026</strong><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">&nbsp;on&nbsp;Thursday,&nbsp;January 15</span><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">th</span><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">, the Chamber&nbsp;will&nbsp;share&nbsp;the results of this critical polling research.</span><strong style="font-size:16px">&nbsp;Panelists will&nbsp;discuss</strong><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">&nbsp;how public opinion is changing, what these changes mean, and what these trends&nbsp;foretell&nbsp;for the year ahead.</span><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong style="font-size:16px">Additionally&nbsp;on January 14</strong><strong style="font-size:16px">th</strong><strong style="font-size:16px">,&nbsp;the Chamber will hold a virtual briefing</strong><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">&nbsp;for members of the media where&nbsp;DHM Research will present the&nbsp;full&nbsp;report&nbsp;ahead of the Breakfast Forum.&nbsp;Information will be</span><strong style="font-size:16px">&nbsp;embargoed until&nbsp;Thursday&nbsp;January 15</strong><strong style="font-size:16px">th</strong><strong style="font-size:16px">&nbsp;at&nbsp;10:00 a.m.</strong><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">Additional&nbsp;details&nbsp;below.&nbsp;Media are&nbsp;encouraged to attend&nbsp;</span><strong style="font-size:16px">both</strong><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">&nbsp;the briefing and the Breakfast Forum.&nbsp;<strong>Please RSVP </strong>with Monice Wong, Media Relations Manager, at&nbsp;</span><a class="Hyperlink SCXW151751294 BCX0" href="mailto:mwong@portlandalliance.com" rel="noreferrer noopener" style="font-size: 16px; -webkit-user-drag: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; user-select: text; text-decoration-line: none;" target="_blank"><span style="color:rgb(70, 120, 134); font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif">mwong@portlandalliance.com</span></a><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">.&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family:aptos,aptos_embeddedfont,aptos_msfontservice,sans-serif; font-size:16px">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong style="color:rgb(75, 0, 130); font-size:18px">Media Briefing – January 14, 12:00 - 1:00 p.m.</strong></p>
</div>

<p>Vancouver, WA — At approximately 4:30 p.m., the Vancouver Fire Department responded to a report of a vehicle into a building at an apartment complex off SE 139th Ave.</p>

The individual was able to exit under their own power and was transported by AMR to a local hospital. The extent of injuries is unknown at this time. One person who lives at the apartment complex was displaced as a result of the incident.&nbsp; Damage costs are unknown. The Vancouver Fire Department’s coordinated response ensured scene safety and minimized further impact to the residents.</p>

<p><strong>Media&nbsp;Contact:&nbsp;</strong><a href="mailto:communications@employ.oregon.gov" target="_blank">communications@employ.oregon.gov</a></p>

<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size:20px"><strong>WorkSource Oregon&nbsp;to Host&nbsp;Second Chance Career Fair in Southeast Portland</strong></span></p>

<p style="text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>PORTLAND, Ore.</strong>&nbsp;—&nbsp;WorkSource Oregon&nbsp;will&nbsp;host&nbsp;its first-ever&nbsp;Second Chance Career Fair&nbsp;on Wednesday, Feb.11,&nbsp;from 10 a.m. to noon at the WorkSource Oregon – Portland Metro Southeast Center in Portland.&nbsp;The&nbsp;free&nbsp;event will&nbsp;connect&nbsp;job seekers with local&nbsp;employers&nbsp;who are&nbsp;open&nbsp;to hiring&nbsp;people&nbsp;facing&nbsp;barriers to employment, including recent incarceration.</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>“This event is about opening doors,” Oregon Employment Department director Andrew R. Stolfi&nbsp;said. “We want job seekers to have direct conversations with employers who value skills, potential, and growth, and who understand that talent exists everywhere.”&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>All job seekers are invited to attend and connect with&nbsp;employers&nbsp;from a range of industries,&nbsp;including healthcare, social services, manufacturing, staffing, and nonprofit organizations. Employers and community partners scheduled to&nbsp;attend include the City of Portland, Dress for Success, Gliss, Central City Concern, United Salad, Stone Soup, DPI Staffing, The Pathfinder Network, Urban League of Portland, and Oxford House.&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>“We encourage attendees to bring copies of their resumes and be prepared to speak directly with employers about current job openings, career pathways, and next steps,” said Reentry Specialist Chelsea Cook, who is coordinating the job fair. “WorkSource&nbsp;Oregon&nbsp;staff will also&nbsp;be available to&nbsp;provide information about job search support and employment services.” Cook specializes in helping people who have been formerly incarcerated find jobs.&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>This is the first time WorkSource&nbsp;Oregon&nbsp;has&nbsp;hosted a&nbsp;career fair focused on&nbsp;second chance&nbsp;hiring&nbsp;but&nbsp;hopes&nbsp;to&nbsp;make&nbsp;it an annual event in the future.&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>Event details</strong>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>Date:</strong>&nbsp;Wednesday, Feb. 11, 2026&nbsp;<br />
<strong>Time:</strong>&nbsp;10 a.m. to noon&nbsp;<br />
<strong>Location:</strong>&nbsp;WorkSource Oregon – Portland Metro Southeast Center&nbsp;<br />
6401 SE Foster Rd., Portland,&nbsp;OR 97206&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>Email: </strong><a href="mailto:EmployerServices@oregon.gov" target="_blank">EmployerServices@oregon.gov</a>.</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>About&nbsp;Workforce Operations</strong>&nbsp;</p>

<p>The Oregon Employment Department’s Workforce Operations division is a partner in WorkSource Oregon, a consortium of state agencies and local workforce boards, and&nbsp;operates&nbsp;37 WorkSource Oregon centers across the state. WorkSource Oregon offers a wide range of free services&nbsp;to job seekers,&nbsp;employers,&nbsp;and businesses, including&nbsp;personalized career coaching, resume writing, job search strategies,&nbsp;support for job postings&nbsp;and&nbsp;hiring incentives, and access to labor-market data. Visit&nbsp;<a href="https://worksourceoregon.org/">worksourceoregon.org</a>&nbsp;for more information.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<hr />
<p>WorkSource Oregon (WSO) is an equal opportunity agency. WSO provides free help so you can use our services. Some examples are sign language and spoken-language interpreters, written materials in other languages, large print, audio, and other formats. To get help, please call 503-947-1680. TTY users call 711. You can also send an email to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EmployerServices@oregon.gov" target="_blank">EmployerServices@oregon.gov.</a>&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>WorkSource&nbsp;Oregon (WSO) es una agencia de igualdad de oportunidades. WSO proporciona ayuda gratuita para que usted pueda utilizar nuestros servicios. Algunos ejemplos son intérpretes de lengua de señas e idiomas hablados, materiales escritos en otros idiomas, letra grande, audio y otros formatos. Para obtener ayuda, por favor llame al 503-947-1680. Usuarios de TTY pueden llamar al 711. También puede enviar un correo electrónico&nbsp;a&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EmployerServices@oregon.gov" target="_blank">EmployerServices@oregon.gov</a>.&nbsp;</p>
